words.zh: n. 遗产；继承物；传统；文化遗产
words.example: The Great Wall is an important part of China's cultural heritage.

words.zh: adv. 创造性地；有创造力地
words.example: Students were encouraged to solve the design problem creatively.

words.zh: adj. 有创造力的；创造（性）的，创作的；有创意的；  n. （非正式）创意人士
words.example: She shared many creative ideas for the school art festival.

words.zh: n. 庙宇，神殿；太阳穴；寺庙
words.example: The ancient temple stands on the hill overlooking the village.

words.zh: n. 遗迹；神圣的遗物；纪念物
words.example: The museum guards every relic found in the old tomb.

words.zh: v. 登上；爬上；骑上；增长；组织，安排；提升；装备；开展；  n. 山；峰；马，坐骑
words.example: We had to mount the steep steps to reach the monastery.

words.zh: adj. 前任的；前者的；以前的；过去的，昔日的；  n. 形成者；（两者中的）前者
words.example: The former palace is now a popular museum for tourists.

words.zh: n. 线索；提示；暗示；迹象；  v. 给……提供线索
words.example: The old map gave the detectives a valuable clue to the treasure.

words.zh: v. 贮存，保鲜；保存；维持；保护；保留；  n. 保护区；独揽之事，独占的活动；腌菜，果酱
words.example: We must preserve these ancient manuscripts for future generations.

words.zh: v. 升职；促进；宣传；促销；推动；提升，升级；发起，创办
words.example: The local government plans to promote tourism around the heritage site.

words.zh: n. 柏树；柏木
words.example: A tall cypress tree grows beside the temple gate.

words.zh: n. 应用程序（application的缩写）
words.example: This new app helps visitors explore the old city easily.

words.zh: n. 运用；申请（书）；应用程序；应用，运用；【计】应用；涂抹，敷用
words.example: The application for the summer camp must be submitted before Friday.

words.zh: phr. 参加（活动）
words.example: Many students take part in the annual cultural heritage quiz.

words.zh: phr. 让路；让位；屈服
words.example: The old buildings gave way to a new shopping center.

words.zh: v. 保持平衡；结算； 比较；抵消；平衡；权衡；结存，结欠；称(重量)；使同等重要；【航】平衡；  n. 平衡，平衡能力；天平；余额；均匀；【物】天平
words.example: You need to balance your study time with enough rest.

words.zh: phr. 保持平衡
words.example: It is important to keep a balance between work and play.

words.zh: phr. 导致
words.example: Too much noise can lead to serious hearing problems.

words.zh: n. 水坝；母兽；  v. 用水坝阻止；阻塞，抑制
words.example: The new dam controls the river and provides water for farms.

words.zh: n. 提议；建议；求婚；提案
words.example: The committee discussed the proposal for the new library.

words.zh: phr. 提出建议
words.example: She made a proposal to protect the ancient wall from damage.

words.zh: v. 抗议；反对（读作/proʊˈtɛst/）；  n. 抗议（读作/ˈproʊˌtɛst/）；反对
words.example: Hundreds of residents gathered to protest against the construction plan.

words.zh: adj. 有可能的；可信的；适合的；有希望的；  adv. 很可能
words.example: The weather is likely to be sunny for the school outing.

words.zh: phr. 求助于；变成，转向；转至
words.example: When you face a problem, you can turn to your teacher for help.

words.zh: n. 委员会；全体委员
words.example: The school committee will decide the date for the cultural festival.

words.zh: v. 建立；创立；确立；使安全；使成为；使确认；证实，确定
words.example: The government plans to establish a new museum in the town.

words.zh: vt. 限制；  n. 限制；限度；极限；【化】极限
words.example: Please limit your speech to five minutes during the presentation.

words.zh: v. 阻止；阻碍；阻挠；预防；【化】阻止，预防；【航】预防
words.example: Wearing a helmet can prevent serious head injuries.

words.zh: v. 阻止；阻碍；阻挠；预防；【化】阻止，预防；【航】预防
words.example: The fence prevented the children from entering the dangerous area.

words.zh: n. 遗失；失败；失去；损失；死亡；减少，降低；缺失；【计】损失
words.example: The loss of the old library was a great blow to the community.

words.zh: n. 贡献；捐款，捐赠；投稿稿件；【财】贡献
words.example: Her contribution to the science project was very valuable.

words.zh: v. 有助于；促成，导致；贡献；投稿；捐赠（款项）；是……的一个原因；增加；增进；添加（到某物）；（做）贡献；【化】促使，促进
words.example: Everyone can contribute to protecting the environment in daily life.

words.zh: n. 部门；（大学）系，部；司；科；（商场里的）部
words.example: The history department organized a visit to the ancient site.

words.zh: n. 资金，基金；专款；储备；  v. 拨款，提供资金
words.example: The school raised enough fund to repair the old hall.

words.zh: prep. 在……之内；  adv. 在内部，在里面
words.example: You must finish the exam within the given time.

words.zh: v. 调查，查明；研究；【化】调查，研究
words.example: The police came to investigate the damage to the ancient statue.

words.zh: n. 问题；争论的问题；议题；发行物；期号；  v. 公布，发布；发行；造成……结果；发给
words.example: The magazine's latest issue features the local cultural heritage.

words.zh: v. 指挥；进行；实施，执行；传导；表现（读作/kənˈdʌkt/） ；带领；指挥（乐团）；组织，实施；安排；【化】传导（热或电等能量）；  n. 经营方式，实施办法；引导（读作/ˈkɑnˌdʌkt/）；（人在某种情况下的）行为举止；行为
words.example: The scientists will conduct a survey about the river's pollution.

words.zh: n. 文件，公文；文献；（计算机的）文档（读作/ˈdɑkjumənt/）；【计】文档；  v. 证明（读作/ˈdɑkjuˌmɛnt/）；记录
words.example: The researcher carefully documented every detail of the ancient tomb.

words.zh: v. 捐献；捐赠；【化】给出，提供
words.example: The businessman decided to donate a large sum to the museum.

words.zh: v. 捐献；捐赠；【化】给出，提供
words.example: She donated her old books to the school library.

words.zh: vi. 消失；失踪；灭绝，消亡
words.example: The ancient custom will disappear if we do not protect it.

words.zh: vt. 试图，尝试；努力去做；  n. 努力，尝试；企图；【化】尝试
words.example: The scientists attempted to preserve the ancient temple.

words.zh: phr. 确保，设法保证；证实；查明；弄清楚
words.example: Please make sure you turn off the lights before leaving.

words.zh: adj. 值得的，有意义的
words.example: It is worthwhile to visit the cultural heritage site.

words.zh: v. 下载；  n. 下载；下载的文件或数据资料
words.example: You can download the app to learn about local history.

words.zh: n. 共和国，共和政体
words.example: The country became a republic after the revolution.

words.zh: n. 专业人员；职业选手；专业人士；  adj. 专业的；职业的
words.example: The professional archaeologists worked carefully at the site.

words.zh: n. 考古学家
words.example: The archaeologist discovered some ancient pottery in the cave.

words.zh: v. 使出神，使入迷；  n. 入口，通道；大门口；出场，登场；进入；（大学等的）进入许可；【航】入口
words.example: The entrance to the museum is on the left.

words.zh: n. 金字塔；棱锥体；【数】棱锥体，角锥体
words.example: The pyramid is a symbol of ancient Egyptian civilization.

words.zh: v. 加工；处理；  n. 步骤，过程；进程；传票；事物发展（自然或偶然的）变化过程；做事方法；工序；【计】进程；【化】过程
words.example: The museum uses special software to process thousands of old photos.

words.zh: adv. 在海外；在外国；  adj. 外国的；海外的
words.example: Many overseas students come to China to study traditional culture.

words.zh: n. 出口；退场；通道；离去，退出；  v. 离开，出去；【计】退出
words.example: Please walk calmly to the nearest exit when the fire alarm rings.

words.zh: v. （雨，雪等）下得很大；  n. 被单；纸张；床单；(冰或水等的)一大片；一张（纸）；【化】玻璃片
words.example: A sheet of ice covered the lake after the sudden cold night.

words.zh: n. 游行；检阅；  v. 游行，（使）列队行进；炫耀
words.example: The band played lively music during the National Day parade.

words.zh: n. 镜子；真实的写照，反映；  v. 反射，反映；【计】镜像
words.example: Her diary is a mirror of her thoughts and feelings.

words.zh: n. 屋顶；顶部；车顶；  v. 覆盖，给……盖屋顶
words.example: Workers are repairing the roof of the old school hall.

words.zh: n. （传说中的）龙；凶暴的人，严厉的人；悍妇
words.example: The dragon dance attracts many people during the festival.

words.zh: v. 饶恕；（国家、银行等）免除（债务）；原谅；宽恕
words.example: I hope you can forgive me for forgetting your birthday.

words.zh: adj. 数字显示的；数码的；电子的；数字的；  n. 数字仪表、时钟；键
words.example: Students use digital tools to create their history projects.

words.zh: vt. 反映；想象；描绘；  n. 形象；图像；印象；影像；想象；【化】影像，图像；【物】像
words.example: The photographer captured a beautiful image of the sunset.

words.zh: n. 山洞，洞穴；  v. 塌落；屈服；洞穴探险
words.example: The explorers discovered ancient paintings inside the dark cave.

words.zh: prep. 在……期间，在整个时期；自始至终；遍及，到处，各处
words.example: The ancient building remained beautiful throughout the centuries.

words.zh: n. 质量；品性；品质；特征；素质；本性，本质；【计】质量；  adj. 优质的
words.example: The quality of the water improved after the new treatment plant opened.

words.zh: phr. 全世界
words.example: People celebrate cultural heritage all over the world in different ways.

words.zh: n. 传统，惯例；传统的信仰或风俗
words.example: Our family has a tradition of making dumplings together on New Year's Eve.

words.zh: adj. 更进一步的；更远的；更多的，附加的；  v. 促进，推动；增进；继续，使......进一步；  adv. 更远地；进一步
words.example: We need further research to understand the ancient city's history.

words.zh: adj. 有历史意义的，历史上著名的；历史性的；古老的；可名垂青史的
words.example: The signing of the agreement was a historic moment for both countries.

words.zh: n. 意见，看法，观点；评价；想法；专家意见；判断
words.example: In my opinion, the museum should be open to everyone.

words.zh: v. 引用；报价；举例说明；【计】引用；【法】报价；  n. 引语，引文
words.example: Our teacher asked us to quote one sentence from the article.

words.zh: v. 解释，释义；  n. 转述，释义
words.example: Can you paraphrase the main idea of this paragraph in your own words?

words.zh: n. 比较；对比；对照；比较等级；比喻；【化】比较，对照
words.example: The comparison between the two photos shows how much the city has changed.

words.zh: n. 差异；对照，对比；对比度（读作/ˈkɑnˌtræst/）；  v. 对照，对比（读作/kənˈtræst/）
words.example: The contrast between the old temple and modern buildings is striking.

words.zh: v. 认出；找到；识别出；发现；确定，鉴定；认同；认为…关系紧密；表明身份；认为……和……一致；认同，共鸣；辨别，区分；【化】鉴定，识别；【航】确定，识别
words.example: Scientists worked together to identify the bones found at the site.

words.zh: adv. 永远；总是，老是
words.example: The beauty of the ancient town will stay in my memory forever.

words.zh: n. 埃及
words.example: Our history class learned about the ancient pyramids of Egypt.

words.zh: n. 埃及人；  adj. 埃及(人)的
words.example: The Egyptian museum contains many treasures from the age of the pharaohs.

words.zh: n. 莫斯科
words.example: The art exhibition will travel from Moscow to Beijing next year.

words.zh: n. 洛杉矶
words.example: My cousin is flying to Los Angeles to study film making.
